{"id":1861853605,"question_id":3626,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months","timestamp":1766346894,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1861853605/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Smallest Divisible Digit Product I","memory":"8.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool check(int n , int t)\n    {\n        int prod = 1;\n        while(n > 0)\n        {\n            prod *= n % 10;\n            n /= 10;\n        }\n        return prod % t == 0;\n    }\n    int smallestNumber(int n, int t) {\n        while(!check(n , t)) ++n;\n        return n;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"smallest-divisible-digit-product-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1367}
